name: vintage-fades
description: Vintage Fades Barbershop - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd admin && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev && cd backend && npm audit --omit=dev && cd ../frontend && npm audit --omit=dev && cd ../admin && npm audit --omit=dev
